format: UCWDC ProAm / ProPro Finals, tied marks

source.quote_free_summary: In ProAm/ProPro judges may give the same medal mark to several contestants; for Couple/Line Dance contests they may not tie contestants.

requirement: A UCWDC engine must accept tied marks for ProAm/ProPro and reject them for Couple and Line Dance.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A blocker to activating any future UCWDC scoring profile (OD-13). A future UCWDC engine must be independently verified, separately versioned (never by editing ordinal_rank@1 or studio_ordinal_majority@1) and evaluated under OD-24. Docs-only record: no compliance claimed.
interpretation_notes: Studio ordinal_rank@1 requires a full 1..N ranking with no ties (engine check V9), so ProAm/ProPro tied marks are unsupported.
decision_refs: OD-13 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A: preserve DanceFlow Studio scoring; retrospective audit PR #795)
